Best Faucet Manufacturer in India

Prayag is widely considered one of the best faucet manufacturers in India, known for its high-quality products, innovative designs, and a wide range of options. With a comprehensive range of faucets, from minimalist to luxurious, Prayag caters to diverse needs, offering complete bathroom and kitchen solutions for every home. As a trusted faucet brand in India, Prayag ensures that its products enhance any space’s functionality and aesthetic appeal.

What are CP Faucets?

Chrome-plated (CP) faucets are crafted by applying a thin layer of chromium to brass or stainless steel, resulting in a shiny, polished look that resists rust and corrosion. These bathroom faucets and kitchen faucets are ideal for spaces where constant exposure to water and moisture demands long-lasting, durable fixtures. As a premier faucet brand in India, Prayag specializes in CP faucet taps that combine style and resilience.

Comprehensive Collection of Prayag’s Faucets

Prayag, a distinguished faucet brand in India, offers an extensive lineup of CP faucets designed to suit various tastes and requirements.

  1. Cygnus: The Cygnus faucet features a sleek design, functionality, and modern appeal. Its smooth chrome finish makes it an excellent choice for today’s bathrooms and kitchens.
  2. Europa: The Europa faucet is minimalist and suitable for homeowners who value simplicity and style. Its compact form fits nicely in smaller spaces while providing excellent water flow control.
  3. Evian: Evian faucets offer a bold and robust appearance with a solid, durable build. The curved shower head adds refinement, making it ideal for modern homes.
  4. Garnet: With its angular design and sharp lines, the faucet is ideal for a bold bathroom addition. Its polished chrome finish feels elegant.
  5. Gracia: Gracia faucets combine timeless design with convenient features, making them easy to use and visually attractive. Their rounded shapes provide a soft, elegant look.
  6. Lagoon: Lagoon faucets offer arc-shaped designs, ensuring ample space and flexibility for kitchen tasks. Their sleek chrome finish complements both modern and traditional kitchens.
  7. Marcus: Marcus faucets are designed for those who prefer a clean and simple look. The easy-to-use handles and smooth spout provide easy control and clutter-free design.
  8. Mist: The Mist faucet stands out for its minimalist and slim design, which is suitable for stylish bathrooms Its simple yet elegant lines enhance the space’s overall design.
  9. Sapphire: Sapphire faucets feature a polished chrome finish and curved spout, making them a stylish and usable addition to any kitchen or bathroom. Their premium look ensures durability and elegance.
  10. Urbana: Urbona faucets bring a modern style with sharp, geometric shapes. They are ideal for stylish spaces that prioritize clean, angular lines.

  12. Zircon: Zircon bathroom faucets are designed for luxurious, high-end bathrooms. Their complex detailing and polished chrome finish blend style and functionality, making them perfect for stylish interiors.

Types of Faucets

Bathroom Faucets

Prayag, a top bathroom faucet manufacturer in India, offers a variety of bathroom faucets to suit different design preferences and functional needs.

  • Pillar Taps: Perfect for sinks and washbasins, pillar taps are easy to use and offer a simple, clean design. They are ideal for minimalist bathrooms where functionality is the priority.
  • Mixer Taps: A mixer faucet allows you to control hot and cold water together, providing easy and accurate temperature control. Taps like this are widely used in washbasins and showers.
  • Wall-Mounted Faucets: Adding a touch of modernity to your bathroom is easy with wall-mounted bathroom faucets. The modern design of these products makes them suitable for bathtubs and washbasins, and they are also available in various styles to suit any decor.

Kitchen Faucets

Prayag’s CP kitchen faucets, crafted by a leading kitchen faucet manufacturer, elevate functionality and style.

  • Single Lever Faucets: One-handled kitchen faucets provide easy water flow and temperature control, making them highly suitable, particularly in a multitasking kitchen.
  • Pull-Down Faucets: Pull-down kitchen faucets allow you to clean the sink, wash dishes, and perform other kitchen tasks more effectively with the pull-down spray head.
  • Deck-Mounted Faucets: Designed for seamless integration with kitchen sinks or counters, deck-mounted faucets provide a sleek, seamless look. With their different designs and finishes, these faucets will perfectly match your kitchen’s decor.

What Makes Prayag’s Bathroom and Kitchen Faucets Stand Out

As a trusted faucet brand in India, Prayag’s CP faucets are distinguished by:

  • Durable and Reliable -  Chrome plating protects faucets from corrosion, rust, and damage. Even in moist surroundings such as bathrooms and kitchens, your faucet will maintain its shine and functionality for many years.
  • Design with Style - CP faucets are known for their modern, sleek design. Their surfaces’ shine and polish complement any modern or traditional decor. These faucets will add a touch of elegance to your bathroom or kitchen and make them a visual centerpiece.
  • Quick & Easy to Maintain - One of the best features of these faucets is how easy they are to clean. A simple wipe with a soft cloth removes water spots, dirt, and grime, keeping the faucets looking brand new without much effort.
  • Anticorrosive - Chrome plating resists rust and corrosion by providing a barrier against moisture. It is, therefore, ideal for areas that receive regular water usage, such as bathroom faucets and kitchen faucets .

Significant Guidelines for Faucet Installation

To ensure optimal performance, follow these installation tips from Prayag, a leading faucet manufacturers:

  •  Appropriate Alignment- Before attaching the faucet, ensure it is aligned with the sink or countertop. This guarantees a secure fit and prevents leaks or improper water flow. Double-check that the faucet is centered over the sink basin.
  • Making Use of the Right Tools and Materials - Have the tools on hand, such as a wrench, plumber’s tape, and silicone sealant. Plumber’s tape on threaded links helps prevent leaks, while silicone sealant can be applied around the faucet base to keep water from dripping into it.
  • Check the Water Supply Lines - Ensure the water supply lines are correctly connected and compatible with your faucet. Replace old or damaged lines to prevent leaks and ensure adequate water flow. Tighten connections securely but avoid overtightening, which can damage the fittings.
  • Test for Leaks After Installation - Once the faucet is installed, turn on the water supply and check for leaks. Check both the faucet and the connections under the sink. Manage leaks instantly by tightening connections or reapplying the plumber’s tape.
  • Follow Manufacturer’s Instructions - Always refer to the faucet’s manufacturer’s installation guide. Each faucet model may have specific requirements or steps for proper installation, and following these guidelines confirms the faucet functions correctly.

Maintenance Guide for Bathroom and Kitchen Faucets

Prayag, a premier faucet manufacturer in India, recommends the following maintenance practices:

  • Regular Cleaning - Wipe down your faucets regularly with a soft cloth and mild soap. Avoid using harsh cleaners or scrub pads that can scratch the chrome finish.
  • Prevent Water Spots - Wipe the faucet dry to control water spots and mineral buildup from hard water. This helps maintain the faucet’s shiny appearance.
  • Monitor for Water Leaks - Sometimes, check your faucets for leaks or drips. If you notice any issues, fix them instantly to avoid further damage to the internal parts. Check bathroom faucets and kitchen faucets periodically.
  • Clean Aerators and Nozzles - Over time, aerators and nozzles can collect dirt and mineral deposits. Unscrew and clean them occasionally to ensure smooth water flow and maintain water pressure.
  • Lubricate Moving Parts - Faucet handles and spouts can become stiff with regular use. Apply a silicone-based lubricant to the moving parts to keep them operating smoothly without strain or noise.
  • Check Water Pressure - Low water pressure can indicate a clogged aerator or internal buildup. Periodically test your faucet’s water pressure and clean or replace the aerator to restore proper flow.
  • Avoid Forceful Turning - Avoid turning the handles too forcefully when using your faucet, as this can destroy the internal parts. The gentle operation helps extend the life of the faucet’s mechanisms.
  • Protect Against Corrosion - Keep the faucet dry after each use to prevent corrosion, Especially important for quality standards followed by leading bathroom faucets manufacturers in India. Apply wax or polish regularly to maintain a protective coating on the chrome surface.

Why Homeowners Prefer Prayag CP Faucets?

Prayag Polymers Limited, counted among the trusted faucet brands in India, is the preferred choice for homeowners due to its focus on quality, durability, and innovation. As one of the reliable faucet brands in India, Prayag aims to deliver high-performance CP faucets that balance functionality, aesthetics, and long-term value.

  • Exceptional performance - Prayag uses only the finest materials to manufacture our faucets. Every faucets chrome plating provides stain and corrosion resistance, and the internal components are solid and reliable to ensure a lifetime of worry-free performance.
  • Multiple Styles and Designs to Choose From - Whether you need a bathroom faucets and kitchen faucets, our collection includes various designs and styles to suit your preferences.
  • Smart Features - Water flows smoothly and efficiently through our faucets because they are prepared with advanced technology. Prayag faucets combine features that make them easy to use and sustainable, including water-saving aerators, temperature controls, and easily operated handles.
  • Value for Money - Prayag CP faucets offer a perfect balance between quality and price. Every home deserves high-quality fixtures, and our CP faucets provide a premium look and feel at affordable prices.
  • Commitment to Excellence- Since Prayag Polymers Limited has been in business for over a decade, homeowners throughout the country have trusted us with their homes. We are the preferred choice for bathroom faucets and kitchen faucets because of our commitment to quality and customer satisfaction.

Contact our support team for more details on Prayag’s CP faucets. As a leading faucet manufacturer in India, Prayag continues to deliver innovative, stylish, and durable solutions for modern homes.

PTMT Taps: The Complete Spectrum

Prayag Polymers Limited, a prominent PTMT taps manufacturer in Delhi, offers a wide range of durable and stylish taps that blend efficiency with modern design.

  1. Bib Cock: A fixed tap with a downward-pointing opening is commonly used outdoors or in gardens. Due to its convenient positioning, it’s ideal for attaching pipes or filling buckets.
  2. Pillar Cock: A single, vertical tap placed on basins or sinks is often used in bathrooms and kitchens. It provides quick and easy water flow for washing hands or utensils.
  3. Sink Cock: Designed mainly for kitchen sinks, this tap usually has a longer lever to reach over the sink basin, making washing dishes and preparing food more accessible.
  4. Angle Cock: A valve that controls water flow to fixtures, mounted at a 90-degree angle. It’s often used as a stop valve for toilets, geysers, and other appliances, allowing maintenance without shutting off the main supply.
  5. Wall Mixer: This faucet combines hot and cold water flows and is hung on the wall. It features dual handles or a single lever to adjust the temperature and is commonly used for showers and bathtubs.
  6. Stop Cock: A valve is used to stop the flow of water in a plumbing system permanently. It’s essential for emergency shut-offs and is usually located where the main water supply enters a building.
  7. Washing Machine Tap with Flange: This specialized tap connects washing machines to the water supply. The fitting offers secure wall mounting and provides a stable and waterproof connection.
  8. Sink Mixer: This is similar to a wall mixer but mounted on the sink. It combines hot and cold water, allowing users to adjust the temperature, and is ideal for kitchen use.
  9. Basin Mixer: This tap is mounted on bathroom basins that mix hot and cold water. It offers temperature control with a single lever or dual handles, improving comfort during use.

Pipes and Fittings

Prayag's Pipes and Fittings illustrate quality and durability, providing solutions to diverse plumbing needs for residential, commercial, and industrial applications. Crafted with high-grade materials, these pipes provide leak-proof and long-lasting performance. The range includes CPVC, UPVC, and PVC pipes designed to efficiently handle hot and cold water flow, making them ideal for potable water systems, agriculture, and drainage solutions.

The fittings are designed for compatibility, resulting in seamless connections across installations. Prayag's products have remarkable resistance to corrosion, chemical exposure, and weather variations, providing reliability in extreme conditions. Installation and maintenance are simple with these pipes and fittings. They are manufactured using advanced technology and comply with international safety and performance standards.

Whether building a new system or elevating one, Prayag's Pipes and Fittings delivers unmatched quality, innovation, and peace of mind for every project.

Pipes and Fittings Categories Offered by Prayag

1. PVC (Polyvinyl Chloride) Pipes and Fittings:

Prayag's PVC Pipes and Fittings are reliable keys for various plumbing and drainage needs. Made from high-quality non-plastic polyvinyl chloride, these pipes are lightweight, durable, and easy to install. They are ideal for cold water supply, sewage systems, and agricultural irrigation, offering excellent resistance to corrosion, chemicals, and weathering.

Fittings are designed to maintain a reliable and leak-proof connection, enhancing system performance. PVC pipes are cost-effective, environmentally friendly, and conform to international safety standards. Prayag's PVC range delivers exceptional efficiency and long-lasting value in every application, whether for residential, commercial, or industrial use.

2. CPVC (Chlorinated Polyvinyl Chloride) Pipes and Fittings:

CPVC pipes and fittings from Prayag deliver superior interpretation in hot and cold water applications. Using chlorine-free Polyvinyl Chloride ensures long-lasting, reliable service, corrosion resistance, and durability. Their versatility makes them suitable for residential, commercial, and industrial applications, offering efficient water flow even under high pressure and temperature conditions. Custom-designed fittings simplify installation and maintenance by delivering a leak-proof connection every time. Prayag's CPVC pipes and fittings have been certified for safety, quality, and environmental sustainability.

3. UPVC (Unplasticized Polyvinyl Chloride) Pipes and Fittings:

Our UPVC pipes and fittings are designed to supply water, drain, and manage cables efficiently. Unplasticized Polyvinyl Chloride pipes are lightweight, durable, and resistant to corrosion, chemicals, and UV rays. Pipes made from UPVC are commonly used for cold water distribution, sewer systems, and electrical conduit applications. They are easy to maintain and require little maintenance. Precision manufacturing ensures leak-proof connections and easy installation. Prayag's UPVC Pipes and Fittings provide residential, commercial, and industrial customers with a cost-effective, long-lasting solution that meets international safety and performance standards.

How PVC, CPVC, and UPVC Differ in Application and Performance

1.PVC (Polyvinyl Chloride):
  • Composition: Contains polymers to make it flexible.
  • Applications: Suitable for cold water supply, drainage, and irrigation.
  • Temperature Resistance: Limited to lower temperatures.
  • Chemical Resistance: Moderate.
  • Durability: Less durable compared to CPVC and UPVC due to added plasticizers.
  • Cost: Most affordable of the three.
2. CPVC (Chlorinated Polyvinyl Chloride):
  • Composition: Chlorinated PVC, making it better heat-resistant.
  • Applications: Ideal for hot and cold water systems in residential and industrial settings.
  • Temperature Resistance: Can handle higher temperatures (up to 93°C/200°F).
  • Chemical Resistance: Excellent, suitable for handling aggressive chemicals.
  • Durability: High, with a long lifespan in hot water systems.
  • Cost: More expensive than PVC but offers superior performance.
3. UPVC (Unplasticized Polyvinyl Chloride):
  • Composition: Rigid PVC with no polymers.
  • Applications: Best for cold water plumbing, electrical conduits, and sewage systems.
  • Temperature Resistance: Suitable only for cold water applications.
  • Chemical Resistance: High resistance to corrosion and chemicals.
  • Durability: Very durable due to its rigid structure.
  • Cost: Priced between PVC and CPVC.

Why Choose Prayag? Their Applications Speak for Themselves

Prayag aims to provide its clients with high-quality pipes and fittings that meet their various needs across various industries. The following applications deserve special mention:

  1. Residential Plumbing: Provides safe and reliable water distribution in homes by providing hot and cold water.
  2. Commercial Buildings: These systems are used in offices, malls, and hotels because they can handle high usage requirements.
  3. Industrial Facilities: These tubes are corrosion-resistant, so water and chemicals can be transported.
  4. Agricultural Irrigation: Provided through drip irrigation and sprinkler systems to ensure adequate water delivery.
  5. Sewage and Drainage Systems: Manage waste and rainwater efficiently through sewer lines and drainage grids.
  6. Electrical Conduits: Serve as protective channels for electrical wiring, safeguarding against environmental factors.
  7. Telecommunication Cabling: Telephone and data cables must be connected securely to ensure the integrity of the signals.
  8. Swimming Pools: Water circulation and filtration systems are incorporated into the pool plumbing.
  9. Rainwater Harvesting: Reuse and storage of rainwater is facilitated through systems that collect and channel rainwater.
  10. Firefighting Systems: Water distribution systems for sprinkler systems and hydrants integrated into fire suppression systems.

Prayag Pipes and Fittings: A Broad Spectrum of Choices

Prayag offers a complete range of pipes and fittings designed for various applications:

1. Agricultural Pipes and Fittings:
  • Agri Pipe: It is used in irrigation systems to maintain proper water distribution in agricultural fields.
  • Agri-Coupler: Securely connects agri pipes to facilitate seamless flow of water.
  • Agri-Elbow: Adapts piping layouts for directional changes without compromising flow rate.
  • Agri-Equal Tee: It facilitates the branching of pipelines, distributing water to multiple areas.
  • Agri-Reducer Coupler: Connects pipes of varying diameters, facilitating adaptability to irrigation setups.
  • End Cap Agri: Seals pipe ends to prevent debris from entering the system and maintain its integrity.
2. CPVC (Chlorinated Polyvinyl Chloride) Pipes and Fittings:
  • CPVC Pipes: Suitable for hot and cold water plumbing in residential and commercial buildings.
  • Brass Elbow: Facilitates 90-degree turns in piping systems, maintaining flow direction.
  • Concealed: Used in hidden plumbing installations for aesthetic and space-saving purposes.
  • Coupling: Joins two pipes of the same diameter, extending the pipeline length.
  • Elbow: Allows for directional changes in piping systems.
  • End Cap and End Plug: Seals pipe ends, preventing leaks and contamination.
  • Expansion Loop: Accommodates thermal expansion and contraction in piping systems.
  • Female Adapter: Connects pipes to male-threaded fittings or fixtures.
  • Male Adapter: Connects pipes to female-threaded fittings or fixtures.
  • Pipe Clamp: Secures pipes to structures, providing strength and support.
  • Reducer Bushing: Connects pipes of different diameters, ensuring smooth flow transition.
  • Reducer Coupling: Joins pipes of varying sizes, facilitating pipeline diameter changes.
  • Reducer Elbow: Allows directional change while connecting pipes of different diameters.
  • Reducer Tee: Enables branching of pipelines with a reduced outlet size.
  • Short Bend: Provides a compact 90-degree turn in piping systems.
  • Step Over Bend: Allows pipes to navigate over obstacles without altering flow direction.
  • Tank Nipple: Connects tanks to pipelines, ensuring secure water flow.
  • Tank Connector: Facilitates connection between storage tanks and piping systems.
  • Tee: Allows for pipelines to be diverged into three directions.
  • Transition Bushing: Connects pipes made of different materials, ensuring compatibility.
  • Union: Provides a detachable connection between pipes, aiding maintenance.
3. SWR (Soil, Waste, and Rainwater) Pipes and Fittings:
  • SWR Pipes: Designed for efficient soil, waste, and rainwater drainage in buildings.
  • SWR-Bend: Facilitates directional changes in drainage systems.
  • SWR-Cleaning Pipe: Provides access points for cleaning and maintenance of drainage lines.
  • SWR-Coupler: Joins two SWR pipes, extending the drainage system.
  • SWR-Cross Tee with Door: Allows for cross-branching with access for cleaning.
  • Door Cap: Seals access points in drainage systems, preventing leaks.
  • Double Y: Enables dual branching in drainage pipelines.
  • Double Y with Door: Provides dual branching with access for maintenance.
  • Floor Trap: Prevents sewer gases from entering living spaces through floor drains.
  • Nahani Trap and Jali: Used in bathrooms to trap debris and prevent clogging.
  • P Trap: Maintains a water seal to block sewer gases in fixtures.
  • Pipe Clip: Secures SWR pipes to walls or structures, ensuring stability.
  • Q Trap: Similar to P Trap but with a different shape for specific installations.
  • Reducer Coupler: Connects SWR pipes of different diameters.
  • Reducer Y with Door: Facilitates branching with a reduced outlet and access for cleaning.
  • Reducer Y: Allows for branching with a reduced outlet size.
  • Reducing Tee with Door: Enables branching with a reduced outlet and maintenance access.
  • Reducing Tee: Facilitates branching with a reduced outlet size.
  • Reverse Y 45: Allows for 45-degree branching in reverse direction.
  • Reverse Y with Door: Provides 45-degree reverse branching with cleaning access.
  • Single Tee: Enables single branching in drainage systems.
  • Single Y with Door: Allows for single branching with maintenance access.
  • Single Y: Facilitates single branching in pipelines.
  • Vent Cowl: Covers vent pipes, preventing debris entry while allowing airflow.
  • Yellow Seal 'O' Ring: Ensures leak-proof joints in SWR systems.
  • Repair Coupler: Used for repairing damaged sections of SWR pipes.
  • Single Y with Door Selfit: Provides self-fitting single branching with access for cleaning.
  • Tee with Door Selfit: Allows for self-fitting branching with maintenance access.

Prayag Pipes and Fittings: The Benchmark of Excellence

Regarding plumbing and piping solutions, Prayag stands as a symbol of unmatched quality, reliability, and innovation. With decades of expertise, a wide range of products, and an adherence to international standards, Prayag ensures seamless performance across residential, commercial, and industrial applications. Whether you're building a home, upgrading infrastructure, or managing large-scale projects, Prayag's high-quality designs and durable materials guarantee long-lasting solutions.

Trust the name that combines advanced technology, affordability, and a proven track record. Choose Prayag Pipes and Fittings because excellence isn't just a promise; it's our standard.
